content: Root cause: The bug was caused by a NullPointerException that occurred when processing deprecated configuration keys in the Hadoop configuration system. The issue arose because the code did not properly handle cases where deprecated keys were accessed without ensuring that the necessary mappings and resources were initialized correctly. The patch introduced changes to ensure that deprecated key mappings were properly populated and processed, preventing the NullPointerException from occurring.
